Every CDDA `plastic_molding` recipe (rucksack, dump_pouch, fanny, mbag, slingpack, boots_winter, elbow_pads) needs 16 charges of makeshift_vacuum_mold. The `holster` use_action and pocket flag restrictions are dropped by the loader, so tool_belt is plain storage. Accepted for this batch per the coordinator.
